text.en: Image storage migration can continue when historical image files are already missing, while preserving records and verifying the files that are moved.
text.zh-CN: 修复历史图片文件缺失时存储迁移停在准备阶段的问题，迁移现有图片并保留历史记录。

text.en: Image storage shows migration status, progress and recovery actions first, with shorter guidance and expandable quota settings.
text.zh-CN: 图片存储弹窗优先显示迁移状态、目标目录和进度，突出继续迁移操作，精简说明并折叠额度设置。
